fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSM) rose 33.2% over past year, significantly exceeding semiconductor sector growth of 6.8%, though falling short of UMC's 112.7% gain
fields.summary_ko.1: TSM Q3 2026 revenue surged 41.2% year-over-year to $46.72 billion, net profit increased 68.7%, with high-performance computing (HPC) revenue growing 22% sequentially representing 68% of total revenue
fields.summary_ko.2: AI accelerator revenue projected to grow at mid-to-high 50% compound annual growth rate during 2024-2029, with advanced technology (7nm and below) representing 79% of wafer revenue
